Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We'd like to do a 60–90 minute live walkthrough of Redwood with our platform team to validate throughput/latency assumptions for our scheduling engine. Attendees will include two customer engineers, a SecOps engineer, and one person from procurement.

Our preferred windows (PT):
- Tue Jul 6: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed Jul 7: 09:00–10:30 or 11:00–12:30
- Thu Jul 8: 13:00–14:30

If those don't work, we can shift the week. Also, procurement will need a brief note on pricing and contract steps in advance so they can prep.

Can you confirm who from Redwood would join (SE + AE + any infra/solutions engineer)? Also: are there any pre-demo security docs we should share ahead of time?

Thanks,

Hi all — quick technical pre-check from my side before we lock the slot.

Key asks so we can prepare a targeted demo:
- Sample throughput: what's the expected concurrent inference QPS and average/session peak sequence length? (ballpark is fine)
- Do you want us to demonstrate the Dedicated routing policy (reserved GPU) or hosted dev flow?
- Any IP allowlist/VPN constraints for streaming endpoints — SecOps, can you flag specific egress/inbound ranges?

I'll attach a short environment checklist that covers credentials, expected payload sizes, and a minimal test dataset we can use. If you can provide a small sample payload (JSON gz ok) that'd be ideal.

Thanks — I'll plan to demo: model routing, kv/prefix cache benefits, and one failure-fallback scenario if network latency spikes.

—Marissa
